title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22686v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents operating over long horizons need an effective memory that allows them to reuse their experience throughout long interactions. If the entire history of an interaction is retained, it becomes difficult to find the relevant experience, while compressing it into summaries may result in the loss of visual and spatial details that are required later on. We present \textbf{MFM}, a multimodal filesystem memory architecture that keeps complementary types of agent memory. \textbf{Episodic memory} stores the observations, actions, and outcomes, and \textbf{spatial memory} associates experiences with locations. \textbf{Semantic and procedural memory} build up general knowledge and reusable methods of acting, and \textbf{working memory} holds the current plans. MFM makes use of searchable textual records to connect these different representations to the underlying multimodal episodes. The agents are able to find previous experiences by means

translated_title: 面向长时程具身智能体的多模态文件系统记忆
translated_abstract: 在长时间跨度内运行的智能体需要有效的记忆机制，使其能够在漫长的交互过程中重复利用自身经验。如果保留交互的完整历史记录，将难以找到相关的经验；而将其压缩为摘要，则可能丢失后续所需的视觉和空间细节。我们提出了MFM，一种多模态文件系统记忆架构，用于保存互补类型的智能体记忆。情景记忆存储观察、动作和结果；空间记忆将经验与位置关联起来；语义记忆和程序记忆积累一般性知识和可复用的行动方法；工作记忆则保存当前的计划。MFM利用可搜索的文本记录将这些不同的表示与底层的多模态情节片段连接起来。智能体能够通过……找到以往的经验。
tldr: 提出多模态文件系统记忆架构MFM，通过情景、空间、语义、程序和工作记忆等互补记忆类型以及可搜索的文本记录，帮助长时程具身智能体有效存储并检索多模态经验。
en_tdlr: MFM is a multimodal filesystem memory architecture that maintains complementary memory types—episodic, spatial, semantic, procedural, and working memory—linked by searchable textual records, enabling long-horizon embodied agents to effectively store and retrieve multimodal experiences.
